function_v0.doc: `[id_this, id_market(this, data)]`. Accepts the market the first time (Q116).
function_v0.name: ids

function_v0.doc: Keeper only. The strategy claims no Alula farm rewards (Q118), so this records\nnothing; it emits `Harvest` so the trait is the same as for strategies that do.\n`data` is ignored.
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc:
Supplies `assets`, pulled from the vault, to the asset's pool of the market named
by `data`, and credits the vault with the j-tokens the Market minted. `change` is the
position's value now minus the value last recorded for it. The protocol total grows by
`assets`, the principal put in (Q89), less what the position's principal stood above
its value (Q90). Refused with `ProtocolRejected` while the pool charges a deposit fee
(or it cannot be read): the core vault would book `assets` while the strategy held
less, and the vault's other holders would pay the fee (Q117).
function_v0.name: allocate

function_v0.doc:
Withdraws `assets` from the market named by `data` and sends them to the vault. An
exit a fee would cut is refused with `InsufficientLiquidity` and nothing moves: while
the pool charges a flat withdraw fee, and whenever a scarcity fee would apply (Q117).
The core vault's withdraw path calls this whatever `max_deallocate` says, so a fee paid
here would fall on the vault's other holders. While another vault holds part of the
obligation, the obligation's whole floor value is refused the same way: the Market
would burn every j-token, the other vault's too. Never gated by approval or the
protocol cap. The protocol total loses the principal taken out (Q89), and whatever of
the rest stands above the position's value (Q90).
function_v0.name: deallocate

function_v0.doc: Value of every position of `vault`: `floor(j_tokens \xc3\x97 S / J)` per market from\n`get_pool`, which reads no oracle; the value last recorded for a market that cannot be\nread. Never fails and never writes.
function_v0.name: real_assets

function_v0.doc: One instance per asset. `factory` decides which vaults may allocate; `cap_authority`\nalone sets the protocol cap; `keeper` alone may call `harvest`; only markets\n`market_manager` deployed are accepted (Q116). All fixed: there is no admin.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: lowers `vault`'s principal in `market`, and the protocol total by the same
amount, to the position's value when that is lower, and emits `PrincipalSynced`.
Never raises it, moves no money and reports no `change`. A position that does not
exist, or a market that cannot be read, is left as it is (Q90).
function_v0.name: sync_position

function_v0.doc:
What `deallocate(vault, data, x)` can pay in this ledger: the smallest of the
position's value, the pool's cash and, when the pool charges for scarcity, what keeps
utilization within its limit, the last two after the interest the withdrawal would book
first; and one unit short of the obligation's floor value while another vault holds
part of it. 0 while the pool is bad-debt locked or charges a flat withdraw fee, on
malformed `data` or on any failed read (Q117). Never writes.
function_v0.name: max_deallocate

function_v0.doc: Sum of the principal every vault has put in and not taken out (Q89).
function_v0.name: total_allocated

function_v0.doc: Cap authority only. 0 removes the cap.
function_v0.name: set_protocol_cap
